help.title: 🌌 Dimensional Hub — Arqon Commands
help.overview: Pick a category in the menu below to see its commands. You can also use slash (`/`) commands.

commands.summon: Summons a random entity from the catalog.
commands.summon_mixed: Summons an entity of any gender.
commands.summon_weapon: Summons legendary weapons and equippable artifacts.
commands.timers: Shows your Pact and summon timers.
commands.pact_up: Checks whether you can forge a Pact now.
commands.rolls_up: Shows how many summons you have left.
commands.info: Inspects the card and stats of an entity.
commands.profile: Shows your Dimensional Profile, Aether and Relics.
commands.dissolve: Dissolves a Pact in exchange for Aether.
commands.daily: Claims the daily Aether and rolls bonus.
commands.wish: Adds or removes an entity from your Wishlist.
commands.top: Shows the most valuable entities in the catalog.
commands.import: Imports a character from AniList into the catalog.
commands.suggest: Suggests a character for the catalog.
commands.approvesuggest: Approves a suggestion and imports the character (staff).
commands.settimer: Sets the Pact cooldown, in minutes.
commands.setclaim: Sets the Pact window, in seconds.
commands.disable: Disables a series in your summons.
commands.antidisable: Re-enables a series in your summons.
commands.firstmarry: Sets the Leader of your Pantheon.
commands.give: Gives an entity to another player.
commands.note: Writes a custom note on the card.
commands.alias: Sets a nickname for an entity.
commands.cleanuser: Releases every pact of a user (staff).
commands.thanos: Dissolves half of the entities without Seals (staff).
